item.title: Verbose beta 348
item.description:
A quicker start

Mac

  • Verbose prepares its built-in word list in the background when it opens. Before, the first dictation or transcript after opening the app waited for the list.
  • Verbose prepares its sounds in the background, so the window responds sooner. Before, the window could pause right after it appeared while the sounds loaded.

Release notes on GitHub
